questions.query: Where is the SQLite WAL checkpoint configured?

chunks.text: The release workflow builds the lean binary and the embeddings binary as separate artifacts.
SQLite checkpoints the write-ahead log when wal_autocheckpoint reaches 1000 pages, set in the open pragma.
The UI theme token for the sidebar is slate-800 and is unrelated to storage.
Continuous integration runs rustfmt, clippy, and the workspace tests.

questions.query: Which port did the staging listener move to after the March change?

chunks.text: In January the staging listener bound port 8080 next to the documentation site.
After the March change the staging listener moved from port 8080 to port 6319.
The production listener has always used port 443 behind the load balancer.
Developer laptops use port 3000 for the local preview server.

questions.query: What should an agent run before reading a whole source file?

chunks.text: Format Rust changes with cargo fmt before opening a pull request.
Run ripgrep for the symbol before reading an entire source file into context.
The logo file lives under the site assets directory.
Pack signatures use Ed25519 over a BLAKE3 digest of the canonical body.
